{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the 'revenue' column: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Verify the clean operation
print("Sample of cleaned 'revenue':")
print(data['revenue_clean'].sample(5))

# Confirm the column is now numeric
print("Data type of 'revenue_clean':", data['revenue_clean'].dtype)"}
